name: Pr Review Fix
description: Skills that fetch the unresolved comments from your PR and fix them with critical sense
longDescription:
Ships **3 skills**.

- **Skills** (3): `dead-code-hunter` (Use this skill whenever the user wants to find unused, unreferenced, or dead code in their codebase), `pr-review-fix` (Use this skill whenever the user wants to address, resolve, or fix PR (pull request) review comments), `test-gap-finder` (Use this skill whenever the user wants to find missing tests, identify untested code paths, write test stubs,…)

Installs with `claude plugin install pr-review-fix@claude-community` from `VincentBoillotDevalliere/sofware-engineer-skills`.
